UI_Talky_Hooks_TokenUnknown: Unknown: start the bridge (0.4.0 or later).

UI_Talky_Hooks_BodyHint: Suggested body on the LibertyTalk side:

UI_Talky_Wf_Steps: Steps (run in order, double-click to edit)
UI_Talky_Wf_JsonHelp: The whole workflow: when, chance, cooldowns, steps

UI_Talky_Set_maxActiveJobs: Max workflows running at the same time
UI_Talky_Settings_Shortcut: Opening key: Options > Keybinds > Talky (F8 by default).
UI_Talky_Settings_File: File: Zomboid/Lua/%1 (reloaded live by the bridge).
UI_Talky_Editor_AdvancedHelp: if / random / repeat / set / chance: see the README
UI_Talky_Editor_BridgeSide: Run by the bridge, not by the game.
UI_Talky_Editor_ActionJsonHelp: Free fields: any parameter of the action
UI_Talky_Act_emit: Send an event to the bridge
UI_Talky_Param_OnGround: On the ground instead of the inventory
UI_Talky_Bridge_TooOld: Bridge older than 0.4.0: game events and Test now need bridge 0.4.0. Update the bridge together with the mod.
UI_Talky_Skip_test_code_mismatch: test code mismatch, press Test now again
UI_Talky_Mode_Solo: Single player: the jobs run in this game.
UI_Talky_Server_Waiting: Multiplayer: waiting for the answer of the server...
UI_Talky_Server_NoAnswer: Multiplayer: no answer from the Talky code of the server. Check the server console.

UI_Talky_Toast_AllowMeSent: Admin role requested from the server
UI_Talky_Reason_disabled: action turned off on the server
UI_Talky_Settings_ServerNote: Multiplayer: the limits below come from the server (Sandbox Options > Talky).
UI_Talky_Server_Ready: Multiplayer: Talky %1 runs on the server.
UI_Talky_Server_YouStreamer: You are a streamer of this server: the events of your live happen around your character.
UI_Talky_Server_NotStreamer: You are not a streamer of this server. An admin adds you in F8 > Webhooks.
UI_Talky_Server_YouAdmin: You manage Talky on this server: streamers (Webhooks page), workflows and game events.
UI_Talky_Server_HostNotAdmin: You host this game but are not admin: click Allow me to manage Talky.
UI_Talky_Server_BridgeOnline: Bridge of the server: connected (v%1, port %2).
UI_Talky_Server_BridgeSolo: The bridge of the server runs in solo mode: restart it with --server.
UI_Talky_Bridge_TooOldServer: Bridge of the server older than 0.5.0: update it, server mode needs 0.5.0.
UI_Talky_Admin_Only: Reserved to the admins of this server (CreateHorde capability: admin or moderator).
UI_Talky_Admin_Loading: Loading the configuration of the server...
UI_Talky_Admin_LoadError: The server could not send its configuration (%1): see the server console.

UI_Talky_Stream_Address: Public address of the bridge (http://<public IP of the server>:<port>)

UI_Talky_Stream_Pending: %1: waiting for the bridge to draw the token...

UI_Talky_Toast_StreamerCopied: URL and token of %1 copied: send them in private
UI_Talky_Toast_StreamerAsked: Request for %1 sent to the bridge
UI_Talky_Ack_error: the server could not write the request
UI_Talky_Toast_SavedServer: Talky: configuration saved on the server
UI_Talky_Save_error: the server could not write the file
UI_Talky_Toast_TestSentServer: Test of "%1" sent: the bridge of the server runs it around you
UI_Talky_Test_bridge_offline: the bridge of the server is offline

UI_Talky_Reason_not_streamer: not a streamer of this server
UI_Talky_Server_BridgeOfflineHelp: Start it on the machine of the server: start-bridge.sh (Linux), start-bridge.cmd server (Windows).
